quarterly_data.quarter: IBM press release: IBM Advances to Stage C of DARPA Quantum Benchmarking (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IBM was selected for Stage C, the third phase of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative (independent verification of approaches to a fault-tolerant quantum computer). Jay Gambetta, Director of IBM Research: 'IBM expects to deliver the first fault-tolerant system in 2029'; IBM's quantum computers are used by a network of more than 340 organizations.
quarterly_data.figure: first fault-tolerant system expected in 2029; more than 340 organizations
